subject.title: fix(agents): preserve target agent tool allowlist for subagents

question: Should target-agent `tools.alsoAllow` be allowed to widen a spawned child beyond the requester session's inherited allowlist?
rationale: The PR's central behavior changes a tool-authorization boundary that current docs and source treat as monotonic, so implementation quality alone cannot settle the intended security semantics.

options.title: Keep Monotonic Inheritance
options.body: Do not let target/global `alsoAllow` widen the requester inherited allowlist; handle delegate-only child tools in the canonical self-deny design instead.

options.title: Approve Explicit Widening
options.body: Allow target-agent widening only after adding explicit docs, deny-wins tests, no-cap regression coverage, and maintainer-visible security rationale.

options.title: Narrow To No-Cap Safety
options.body: Require this PR to avoid creating inherited allow caps for unrestricted parents while pausing the target-over-parent grant for separate design review.

recommendation.title: Keep Monotonic Inheritance
recommendation.body: Do not let target/global `alsoAllow` widen the requester inherited allowlist; handle delegate-only child tools in the canonical self-deny design instead.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent is the strongest current-history owner for the inherited tool-policy code path and adjacent agent security boundary.
